reading.body:
Digital Realty CH2 is a 328,000 square foot data center at 2299 Busse Road in Elk Grove Village, part of a multi-building Chicago metro campus near O'Hare airport that includes at least three other named facilities in Franklin Park on the same street corridor. The facility offers N+2 UPS redundancy, which qualifies it to host workloads with high availability requirements. Individual building critical IT power capacity is not confirmed from a published tier-1 source.

Illinois has 44 mapped data center facilities, of which only 6 publish power capacity figures totaling 236 MW. This campus ranks seventh among Illinois facilities by published megawatts, meaning five facilities in the state have disclosed larger capacities and at least 37 mapped facilities publish no power figure at all. The actual distribution of AI-relevant capacity in Illinois remains largely unknown.

Without published megawatt figures for this building, its role in AI scaling cannot be assessed from available data. The campus location near O'Hare and its clustered multi-building design suggest intended density, but power budgets and cooling infrastructure remain unpublished and determine whether this site functions as AI-grade compute infrastructure or general-purpose colocation.
